system.description:
Activate Free (0 AP)

Trigger Once per round when the weapon inflicts a Critical hit upon a disembodied spirit, incorporeal Undead or possessing entity

The rune resembles an open doorway crossed by a single violent stroke.

The target suffers 2d6 secondary essence damage and must attempt a Will saving throw against your Level DC.

Critical: The target is unaffected beyond the additional damage.

Success: It cannot attempt possession until the beginning of your next turn.

Failure: It cannot attempt possession for 1 minute.

Fumble: As Failure. If it is currently possessing a creature, immediately attempt to Counteract the possession using your level as the Counteract level. If the Counteract succeeds, the possession ends normally.

Inscribed onto a weapon.

On the sheet: Applied on a Critical against an Undead creature, once a round: 2d6 essence on the damage card, then the creature's Will save against your Level DC with the printed ladder. Against a disembodied spirit or a possessor the system cannot see, the GM adds it. A Fumble's Counteract of a possession is the table's.

Pillars of Faith, Chapter 11.
